results: File menu Close uses dirty save/discard/cancel lifecycle and only closes selected tab
native File menu Exit cancellation preserves every document, bytes and checkpoint
save all writes exact original files then checkpoints and destroys once
later file-save failure reports partial save, retains remaining dirty document and resumes editing
discard success removes only dirty recovery, retains clean third document and original files
recovery-only choice preserves unsaved bytes without writing original files

failures.name: discard batch abort is atomic across dirty documents and preserves clean third-document checkpoint
discard destroy failure atomically restores removed checkpoints before editable state returns
